source.name: NCES IPEDS annual academic-year student charges, 2000–2023
source.coverage: Fixed UNITID panels; separate public in-state/out-of-state tuition and required fees, private nonprofit tuition, and on-campus room/board. Equal-school geometric price levels, not national enrollment-weighted prices.

equityCrosscheck.source: Vanguard VCMM public US equity 10-year outlook
equityCrosscheck.rangeMeaning: Two-percentage-point range around median expectations, not prediction-interval endpoints. Used only as an alternative planning anchor.

macro.interpretation: Named assumption cases, not probability-weighted scenarios. Survey quartiles measure forecaster disagreement, not predictive coverage. BOND10 is expected Treasury yield used as a provisional return anchor, not a measured fund-return forecast.

notes: 23 paired academic-year transitions, 2001–2023. Market returns and CPI anchors retain the preceding economic snapshot; college-cost growth now uses fixed-institution panels.
Public in-state and out-of-state tuition growth are separate. Housing uses its own on-campus institution panel; at-home/off-campus and other expenses use general CPI.
Complete-record survivorship selection: closed, reclassified and incomplete institutions are excluded using full-window membership. Tests are retrospective, not real-time vintage experiments.
Tuition and housing panel membership differs. Housing is on-campus budget, not local rents. Source imputation flags are retained and counted, not silently treated as directly observed quotes.
School counts do not multiply independent economic periods. Public/private and residency series share institutions and macro history.
Cost-trend comparison uses a development/final-period split; funding probabilities remain conditional on assumptions.
Investment simulation now starts at observed five-year and bill yields (2026-10); Treasury returns are repriced and bill accrual reinvests at simulated rates.
Central-case state-conditioned source blocks are shared across cases and students; each path also draws persistent joint expectation deviations from observed rolling-ten-year regimes.
Cost correction enabled by a frozen 2024–25 score gate. One new independent target-year shock cannot establish probability calibration.

sources.units: Annual investment-basis yield, decimal fraction; monthly average

sources.name: Federal Reserve H.15 via FRED TB3MS
sources.units: Annual bank-discount quote, decimal fraction; monthly average

limitations: Treasury exposure is a hypothetical monthly-rolled five-year instrument with semiannual coupons and monthly-average yields, not an actual fund return.
Cash accrues at the start-of-month bill quote; the 91-day/365-day equivalent is a reinvestment approximation.
State-conditioned blocks change source-year weights, not a structural causal model. Parameter bounds are explicit numerical model limits, not predictive guarantees.
Persistent expectation dispersion comes from overlapping ten-year windows; no independent probability calibration follows.

costCorrection.method: Paired annualized log errors of training-only nominal price forecasts; persistent draw per household path, independent of macro-expectation draw.
